package records

import "testing"

func TestUpdateTitle(t *testing.T) {
	records := map[string]Record{"r1": {Tenant: "alice", Title: "old"}}
	if err := Update(records, "alice", "r1", "new"); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if got := records["r1"].Title; got != "new" {
		t.Fatalf("title = %q, want new", got)
	}
}
